# #4149: Patch: follow-up to #4136 from the after-merge spot-check
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

<!-- jackioh-bot:spot-check-follow-up #4136 -->
The after-merge spot-check of #4136 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44189772495)) found 1 blocking problem(s) in the change as it merged (`77cb282e6d7d`). `claude-4` (claude, `opus`, strong) reviewed it. #4136 stays merged: nothing is reverted, and this issue fixes what it found in a change of its own, from `main`.

## What to fix

- [ ] `apps/web/src/i18n/i18n.test.ts:293`: The new table walk checks only the `boardNames` entry of `CARD_SETTINGS_FIELDS`. The issue asked it to walk the card settings' fields, and the README now says it does, but a new or reworded label or description on any other field (`hoverPreviews`, `rarityFoil`, `animatedFoil`, `fullArt`, `setWatermarks`, `opponentCosmetics`, `deviceTilt`) would show in English to a Chinese reader and no test would fail.
  Evidence: The walk does `CARD_SETTINGS_FIELDS.find((field) => field.key === "boardNames")` and pushes only that field's label and description. `settings/controls.tsx:178` and `:194` (`t(field?.label ?? setting)`, `t(field.description)`) and `:240` and `:270` pass every other field's label and description to `t()` through a variable, which the literal scan cannot see. The issue's list of tables names "the card settings' fields and the board-names options", and the acceptance item asks the walk to fail on a missing entry in "any of those tables". The README sentence added in this diff says "the card settings' fields and the board-names options … are walked". Every field has an entry today (I checked all 16 strings against zh-CN.json), so the fix is to loop over every field in the walk instead of finding one.

## Done when

- Each finding above is fixed where it points, or answered with the evidence that it does not hold.
- Every check is green, with no test skipped, ignored or weakened to get there (CLAUDE.md rule 12).

| File | New / change | What changes there |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/i18n/i18n.test.ts` | change | Lines 292-296: replace the `find(key === "boardNames")` block with a loop over all of `CARD_SETTINGS_FIELDS` |

Must not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/` (forbidden); `spec/` (no rules decision, so no ruling note); `apps/web/README.md` (line ~1463 already says the card settings' fields are walked); `apps/web/src/cards/settings.ts`, `apps/web/src/settings/controls.tsx`, `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` (all correct as-is; every field has an entry today). ## Steps

1. In `apps/web/src/i18n/i18n.test.ts`, in the `it("R711000 every table-fed sentence has a zh-CN entry", …)` block, delete lines 292-296:
   ```ts
   const boardNames = CARD_SETTINGS_FIELDS.find((field) => field.key === "boardNames");
   if (boardNames !== undefined) {
     fed.push({ table: "boardNames", value: boardNames.label });
     fed.push({ table: "boardNames", value: boardNames.description });
   }
   ```
   and insert in the same place:
   ```ts
   for (const field of CARD_SETTINGS_FIELDS) {
     fed.push({ table: "CARD_SETTINGS_FIELDS", value: field.label });
     fed.push({ table: "CARD_SETTINGS_FIELDS", value: field.description });
   }
   ```
   Copy the `fed.push({ table: …, value: … })` pattern from the `ANOMALIES` / `MARK_WORDS` loops directly above (lines 286-290). Leave line 297 (`for (const option of BOARD_NAMES_OPTIONS) fed.push({ table: "boardNames", value: option.label });`) and lines 299-301 (the `missing` / `expect(missing).toEqual([])` / `expect(fed.length).toBeGreaterThan(100)` assertions) unchanged; the longer `fed` list only grows the count.
2. Prove the walk is now sensitive (temporary negative check, reverted before finishing): in `apps/web/src/cards/settings.ts` line 62, change `"Hover previews"` to `"Hover previews probe"`, run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/i18n/i18n.test.ts`, and confirm the `table-fed` test fails with a line containing `CARD_SETTINGS_FIELDS: "Hover previews probe"`. Then revert that one-word edit with no other change (`git diff` must show only `i18n.test.ts` afterwards).
3. Run the full check in **Tests** and confirm green.

## Tests

- Existing test, no new test needed: `apps/web/src/i18n/i18n.test.ts`, `it("R711000 every table-fed sentence has a zh-CN entry")` — it now asserts all 16 field strings (8 labels + 8 descriptions from `CARD_SETTINGS_FIELDS` in `apps/web/src/cards/settings.ts:57-107`) have `zh-CN.json` entries, plus the unchanged `BOARD_NAMES_OPTIONS` labels. The temporary probe in step 2 is the regression proof that the walk fails on any other field; it is reverted, not committed.

- [ ] The walk loops over every field in `CARD_SETTINGS_FIELDS` instead of finding `boardNames` only.
- [ ] The temporary probe fails naming `CARD_SETTINGS_FIELDS` and the value, then is reverted so the only diff is `apps/web/src/i18n/i18n.test.ts`.

- Failure-message table names change for the `boardNames` field strings (from `boardNames:` to `CARD_SETTINGS_FIELDS:`).
